ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, it is known that point $D$ is on segment $AB$, and point $C$ is the midpoint of segment $AB$. If $AB=8\,\text{cm}$ and $BD=3\,\text{cm}$, what is the length of segment $CD$ in cm?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that point $C$ is the midpoint of line segment $AB$,\\
hence, $CB = \frac{1}{2}AB = 4\,\text{cm}$,\\
thus, $CD = CB - BD = 4 - 3 = 1\,\text{cm}$,\\
meaning the length of line segment $CD$ is \boxed{1}\,\text{cm}.
